$comment: Machine-readable extract for agents. HAND-MAINTAINED, not generated — an earlier comment claimed it was generated from tokens/tokens.json, but nothing generates it. Saying so is the honest fix; npm run content now compares the values here against tokens/tokens.json so the two cannot drift apart in silence.
colorLivesOnlyIn: nowhere — black, grey and white only; imagery separates series by pattern

grade.why: light ink on a dark ground reads heavier at the same weight; Inter has no GRAD axis, so the compensation rides the continuous wght axis, bounded to under a quarter of a weight step so no role crosses into the next named weight

spacing.appendOnly: steps are frozen by index: --space-5 names 24px permanently. Add at the end or not at all — checked against SPACE_FROZEN at generation time.

motion.guarded: transform and position run only under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); no token yet, because no surface moves
motion.reducedMotion: substitution, never deletion: the guard removes the transform and the guard-free colour change stays, so the feedback survives
motion.gate: the stylesheets are scanned at generation time; a transform transition fails the build until MOTION.gesture and MOTION.easeIn are filled in, and an animated layout property fails it outright

method.approach: Lightness solved by bisection against two contrast standards at once (WCAG 2 and APCA), against the most demanding ground
method.decorIsSetting: --decor is set, not solved: decoration has no contrast target by definition
method.monochrome: no colour anywhere, paper and ink included: every value is a pure grey (OKLCH chroma <= 0.004, checked by npm run chroma)
method.whyBoth: WCAG 2 is symmetric and cannot see polarity: dark tertiary scored 4.54 against its light twin's 4.52 while reading 22.3 Lc weaker. APCA alone would drop the light band under AA (6.86 and 3.99). Which standard binds differs by band — WCAG binds the light band, APCA binds the dark one.

rules: No exclamation mark as punctuation; as a shape in the imagery layer it is allowed.
Decorative images carry alt="", not no attribute at all.
Icons live locally as SVG, never from a CDN.
Never edit tokens by hand — _scripts/derive-tokens.mjs is the specification.
A number without a source is an assertion: every usage figure carries value, unit, source and date.
Radius follows the surface, not the token name. --radius-card on a small field makes a circle.
